summary: Crypto sentiment is mixed: Bitcoin has reclaimed $60,000 but remains below key resistance in a broader lower-highs trend, while Michaël van de Poppe is constructive on selected altcoins and expects a stronger first quarter of 2027.[1][4] Gold is caught between safe-haven demand and higher-rate pressure, while oil is strongly bullish after attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure.[1][5][7]
